meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理数据时会用 uv 运行 Python,始终带上 numpy 和 pyarrow;根据操作类型在 DuckDB 和 Polars 间选工具,不用 pandas。能直接查询 CSV 等文件,完成过滤、排序、分组、聚合,并报告处理时间和行数。
howto.when: 当你说出“分析数据”“分析这个文件”“汇总一下”等,或要求分组、过滤、排序、合并文件、处理大数据时触发;纯文本、配置和小计算不触发。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV 文件,按类别汇总总金额。
say.note: 会用 DuckDB 直接查询文件并返回结果。

say.text: 这个数据集超过内存了,帮我按月算趋势。
say.note: 会采用流式或外核方式处理大文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude processes data using uv-run Python, always bundling numpy and pyarrow; it selects between DuckDB and Polars based on the operation and never uses pandas. It can query files like CSV directly, do filtering, sorting, grouping, aggregation, and reports timing and row counts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say things like 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'summarize this', or ask for grouping, filtering, sorting, merging files, or handling large datasets; not for plain text, configs, or small calculations.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV and sum amounts by category.
say_en.note: DuckDB queries the file directly and returns results.

say_en.text: Join orders.csv with customers.csv, then filter amount > 100.
This dataset exceeds RAM; compute monthly trends.
say_en.note: Switches to streaming or out-of-core processing.
